scientific_purpose: Controlled broad-population A4 test of fresh CheMeleon readouts: full versus primary-selected class supervision, each with/without all-primary auxiliary targets. Hidden weak class labels excluded from both losses and threshold selection; restore only outer evaluation. Test whether representation/auxiliary learning addresses the observed selection reversal.
selection_rule: Prespecified 20-epoch matched architecture and all-primary weight .2, no epoch/weight grid. Compare model decisions and population coverage before preparing a payload. Counts remain outputs.
limitations: Frozen generic molecular encoder features are reused, never prior challenge predictions. Feature standardization and class/primary supervision exclude all held-out groups. D6 weak-primary labels remain unavailable; A4 population control does not prove D6 transport. Conditional intervals omit protocol selection and fitting uncertainty.
